answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 145861 Country: Uae Title: Can I take fees to teach Quran? Question: Can I take fees to teach Quran? Answer ID: 145861 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 74/55/N=2/1438) The later scholars of Hanfi Fiqh have allowed taking fees of teaching the Holy Quran due to the need. Hence it is right to take fixed monthly, quarterly, half yearly fees upon teaching the holy Quran. ويفتى اليوم بصحتها لتعليم القرآن الخ . (الدر المختار ، كتاب الإجازة ، باب الإجازة الفاسدة ، 9: 76 ، ط: مكتبة زكريا ديوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
